name: Introduction to Computer Programming
description: Introduction to programming in Fortran/C++, history/overview, environment setup, understanding editor, compiler, and terminal, writing, compiling and executing a program. Declaration of variables and constants, data types, console input/output, formatting, operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, pointers, basic input-output, file input-output, functions/subroutines, modules, libraries, debugging. Introduction to python, plotting with python, Gnuplot and/or Xmgrace.
